'''2020 TMW Pods Matt Lutz LS The Hyperdrive Generator's Gone (V)''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Matt Lutz]] at [[2020 Texas Mini Worlds]] (Pods).


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Matt Lutz]]
* '''Event:''' [[2020 Texas Mini Worlds]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Yavin 4: Massassi Throne Room|Premiere-L-yavin4massassithroneroom.gif}}
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:Open The Hyperdrive Generator's Gone 6.txt |Download]]
* '''Format:''' [[Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Pods
* '''Source:''' [https://www.starwarsccg.org/2020-texas-mini-worlds/ PC list]. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20201027000438/https://www.starwarsccg.org/2020-texas-mini-worlds/ Internet Archive]
